messages.subject: Marsden — first thoughts before we advise
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom — I've read the grievance and the November Calderwater email. Constructive dismissal is no better than borderline (title/salary/board seat all preserved, clause 3 variation power), but the whistleblowing limb is the real risk: uncapped, and it drags the auditors' file and board papers into disclosure. I think we recommend settling and reaffirming the covenants, recutting the non-compete to 9 months. Can you draft the advice note for Friday? Range: open ~£75k, target £95k, walk-away ~£115k all-in.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield | Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Agreed on all of that. I'll have the advice note over to you this morning and we can send to Gavin, Rebecca and Helen. On covenants — the 12-month non-compete looks vulnerable for a sales director; 9 months from termination, with garden leave set off, is far more defensible.

Best,
